data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (city, special events, open event, ticket count, ticket option, Reserve Now) and names city and ticket quantity as parameters, but it omits the date parameter, adds an event-name parameter and a ticket-type parameter in place of the date, and leaves the city-selection step vague, so an automation would still be mostly buildable.
